guard: a plain line question settles as a cancel when its input ends, closes, or takes Ctrl-D or Ctrl-C, and no CLI source asks a readline question outside askLine
why: The plain removal questions of channel remove and persona remove read one line with readline. A closed input only closes readline, which leaves its question pending, so the process exited 13 with Node's unsettled-await warning. A line with no newline before the input ended was not an answer either, and it also left the question pending.

askLine asks through untilInputEnds, whose abort rejects the question, and readline itself rejects it for Ctrl-D on an empty line and for Ctrl-C. Each AbortError is the cancel. The suite drives askLine over in-memory streams, in terminal mode for the keypress cases, and a census reads the CLI sources.
The suite command builds the CLI and its dependencies first and imports workspace's dist, so each mutation rebuilds in afterRestore.

mutations.name: the line question ignores the input-end abort
mutations.expectRed: closed input settles a plain line question as a cancel
mutations.cell: closed input settles a plain line question as a cancel
mutations.note: The pre-fix question: readline closes on input end and its question stays pending.

mutations.name: readline's own Ctrl-D rejection escapes as an error
mutations.find: if ((error as { name?: unknown } | null)?.name === "AbortError") return undefined;
mutations.expectRed: Ctrl-D on an empty plain line question settles it as a cancel
mutations.cell: Ctrl-D on an empty plain line question settles it as a cancel
mutations.note: Readline rejects Ctrl-D before the input-end abort runs, so only the AbortError check makes it a cancel.

mutations.name: persona remove asks a raw readline question again
mutations.expectRed: no CLI source asks a readline question directly; a plain line question goes through askLine
mutations.cell: no CLI source asks a readline question directly; a plain line question goes through askLine
mutations.note: The released persona.ts question, with its import inlined so the mutant still compiles.
